newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: ALPINE SKIING-SWISS PART WAYS WITH CHEESE SPONSORS.
newsitem.headline: ALPINE SKIING-SWISS PART WAYS WITH CHEESE SPONSORS.

text.p: The Swiss ski team's flashy yellow suits with the cheese-hole motif will be scrapped from next season after the national federation and their cheese sponsors said they were parting ways on Wednesday.
The Swiss Cheese Union said it would not be renewing its contract, begun in 1992, after the 1998 Winter Olympics in Nagano, Japan.
The team relied on the semi-government organisation to provide a huge wedge of financing, totalling 1.8 million Swiss francs ($1.3 million) last year.

"We regret it (the decision) because the Cheese Union was not only a good partner financially, but also because athletes could identify with the product," Swiss Skiing Association director Josef Zenhaeusern said. "The dress was unique."
